# Weekly Routine

> Used by `ngn-earnings-research`, `uk-earnings-research`, `us-earnings-research`.

## Morning Check (Daily, ~15 min)

- [ ] Check task boards for new AI-training batches
- [ ] Complete 2 surveys / microtasks on rotation platforms
- [ ] Check for bank-switch/cashback offers (if eligible)

## Daily Targets

- [ ] Earnings logged in `trackers/earnings_tracker.xlsx`
- [ ] Minimum daily goal met: {amount}

## Weekly Blocks

| Slot | Activity | Platform rotation |
|| ---- | -------- | ----------------- ||
| Mon AM | Surveys | platform A, B |
| Mon PM | User testing | platform C |
| Tue AM | AI training | platform D |
| Tue PM | Freelance gigs | platform E |
| Wed … | … | … |

## Weekly Review (End of Week)

- [ ] Update `trackers/weekly_planner.md`
- [ ] Review platform ratings; drop underperformers
- [ ] Plan next week's rotation
- [ ] Verify tax tracker total vs threshold
